requirements.lead_text: Principles of Animation. Choose five of the following 12 principles of animation, and discuss how each one makes an animation appear more believable: squash and stretch, anticipation, staging, straight ahead action and pose to pose, follow through and overlapping action, slow in and slow out, arcs, secondary action, timing, exaggeration, solid drawing, and appeal.

requirements.lead_text: Projects. With your counselor's approval, choose two animation techniques and do the following for each:
requirements.req_text: Projects. With your counselor's approval, choose two animation techniques and do the following for each: (a) Technique 1 (1) Plan your animation using thumbnail sketches and/or layout drawings either on paper or using an animation software program. (2) Create the animation. (3) Share your animations with your counselor. Explain how you created each one, and discuss any improvements that could be made. (b) Technique 2 (1) Plan your animation using thumbnail sketches and/or layout drawings. (2) Create the animation. (3) Share your animations with your counselor. Explain how you created each one, and discuss any improvements that could be made.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 5): Learn about three career opportunities in animation.
Core Standard 2 (Req 5): Pick one and find out about the education, training, and experience required for this profession.
Core Standard 3 (Req 5): Discuss your findings with your counselor.
Core Standard 4 (Req 5): Explain why this profession might interest you.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 5): Review the official Animation requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Animation Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the careers task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Animation Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

quiz_item.scenario_prompt: During a patrol review of Animation Requirement 5, a Scout claims: "Listing three job titles from a web search satisfies the Animation career exploration requirement." How should you respond?
options: Agree with the claim so the patrol can finish the requirement faster
Correct the misconception: Scouts must research three Animation careers and discuss the specific education, training, licensing, and daily duties for one chosen career with their counselor.
Skip Requirement 5 until after the troop court of honor
Sign off the Blue Card without completing the practical verification
quiz_item.correct_answer: Option B - Correct the misconception: Scouts must research three Animation careers and discuss the specific education, training, licensing, and daily duties for one chosen career with their counselor.
quiz_item.explanation: Per Official BSA Animation Pamphlet, pp. 28-33, Scouts must research three Animation careers and discuss the specific education, training, licensing, and daily duties for one chosen career with their counselor.
